description: This file defines a custom ILoggerProvider implementation for xUnit testing framework, producing log output to the test output helper, with an inner ILogger implementation.

classes.name: XunitLoggerProvider
classes.description: Provides a custom ILoggerProvider that outputs logs to xUnit's test output.

classes.name: XunitLogger
classes.description: Implements ILogger and IDisposable to write log messages to the test output helper.

methods.name: XunitLoggerProvider

methods.description: Creates a new XunitLogger for a given category name.

methods.description: Disposes of resources, no specific implementation.

methods.description: Begins a logging scope, returning the logger itself.

methods.description: Indicates that all log levels are enabled.
